It is also explicitly cited or mentioned in later non-canonical Pali literature, specifically in the *Milindapañha* (Mil 3.2.4, *Paṭisandahanapuggalavediyanapañha*).

 The full sequence of verses (§§1.1–11.5) is preserved and commented upon in the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, with additional substantial reuse found in the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. Cross-tradition alignments computed by DharmaNexus also note a textual match between segments 9.1–9.3 and the Chinese translation of the *Madhyama-āgama* (T 26) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
